instagram.caption:
The bottle you are keeping out of guilt.
The Shower or Tub in the Primary Bathroom. To keep only the products actually in use within reach, on surfaces that dry out between showers.

What done looks like:
1. One bar per person in the caddy. A squeegee on its hook inside the enclosure
2. Grip strips or a mat with real suction on the floor
3. No dark line where the wall meets the tray

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success shower or tub.
